subject: End-of-term settlement: invoice aggregation, PO conversion, and payment migration
messages:
From: Nadia Khan <payments@acme-corp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Question: final invoice split & PO conversion for renewal true-up

Hi Jasmine,

We're preparing the closeout for our Redwood renewal and I need help with how you want the final true‑up invoicing to be handled. We currently have a standing PO (PO# 7892) that our procurement team prefers to apply rather than issue multiple ad‑hoc POs. A couple specifics: 

- Can Redwood issue a single aggregated invoice that covers the term charges + true‑up line items, and indicate the PO number on each invoice?
- If you need the PO converted into multiple invoices (by line item / quarter), what format do you need for the PO conversion?
- We may route the payment through our central escrow as this is an end‑of‑term settlement — is that supported?

I've attached the PO for reference. If possible, please send a short playbook for the collection steps so procurement knows what to expect.

Thanks,
Nadia Khan
Payments Lead, Acme Cloudware
[Attachment: Acme_PO_7892.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <payments@acme-corp.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: final invoice split & PO conversion for renewal true-up

Hi Nadia — thanks for the note and the PO. Putting a short collection playbook below so procurement has a single place to follow. CC'ing Priyom (sales) and Rafael (finance) to own execution.

Proposed collection playbook (high level):
1) Invoice format: Redwood can issue a single aggregated final invoice that includes: term charge (prorated if applicable), the true‑up line, and a PO reference (PO# 7892) on the invoice header and each line.
2) PO conversion: If Acme needs multiple invoices, we can split by line item or by billing period — provide the preferred split (e.g., Q3/Q4 or by product line) and we will generate separate invoice PDFs that each reference the original PO number.
3) Escrow/third‑party payment: Redwood supports routing payments to a designated escrow account; procurement must provide the escrow account details and the legal POC for any holding instructions.
4) Timeline: once we have final split instructions and escrow details, finance will issue invoice(s) within 2 business days. Payment terms per contract (NET 30) unless an alternative is pre‑agreed.

Next steps for Acme: please confirm (A) whether you want a single aggregated invoice or a split set, and (B) if using escrow, provide escrow account name and contact. Rafael — can finance prepare the aggregated invoice template and a split option so we can pick quickly?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: Nadia Khan <payments@acme-corp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Mendez <procurement-acme@example.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: final invoice split & PO conversion for renewal true-up

Hi Jasmine — thanks, that works. Acme prefers the aggregated invoice with the PO number on every page. We'll not split unless Redwood recommends it for accounting reasons.

Escrow details below:
- Escrow agent: Flagstone Escrow Services
- Account reference: ACME-ESCROW-2027
- Escrow POC: Carlos Mendez (procurement-acme@example.com)

Attached is the signed PO (again) and a short note from procurement confirming they accept NET 30 against the aggregated invoice. Let me know if you need any additional paperwork.

Regards,
Nadia
[Attachment: Acme_PO_7892.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-04T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action: prepare final invoice + PO reference (ACME-2024-RED-09)

Rafael / Jasmine — Per Nadia's confirmation, Acme wants a single aggregated final invoice referencing PO# 7892 and routed to their escrow agent. Rafael, can you produce two deliverables: (1) the aggregated final invoice PDF with line-level breakout showing the true‑up calculation, and (2) a short Payment Instructions CSV that includes bank/wire details and the escrow reference?

Numbers to show on the invoice: base term charge $112,500; usage true‑up $18,750; tax/VAT (if applicable) — Redwood should indicate VAT treatment and show amounts per line. Use deal_id ACME-2024-RED-09 as the invoice reference.

Target: Rafael to send draft invoice and payment instructions to this thread by EOD Monday 9/6 so Nadia can route to Flagstone.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <payments@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-06T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final invoice and payment instructions (ACME-2024-RED-09)

Hi Nadia / Carlos — attaching the final true‑up invoice and a CSV with payment instructions for routing to Flagstone Escrow. Per your preference we issued a single aggregated invoice that includes the PO number on the header and every page.

Invoice highlights:
- Invoice #: RWI-2027-0916-ACME
- Reference / Deal ID: ACME-2024-RED-09
- Base term charge: $112,500.00
- Usage true‑up: $18,750.00
- VAT (0% exempt) — see tax note below
- Total due: $131,250.00
- Due date: 2027-10-06 (NET 30)

Tax/VAT note: Acme is VAT‑exempt for this contract per the W‑8/B2B documentation on file; we have left the VAT line visible and set to 0% with the exemption reason in the invoice footer. If you require a VAT‑charged invoice, reply with your tax residency and VAT registration and we'll reissue.

Payment routing provided in Payment_Instructions.csv. Please ensure Flagstone Escrow references the invoice number RWI-2027-0916-ACME in the transfer reference so we can match the payment.

[Attachment: Final_TrueUp_Invoice_202709.pdf (PDF, 132KB)]
[Attachment: Payment_Instructions.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

If all looks good, let me know and we'll mark the invoice ready for collection and send a remittance request to finance.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Finance — Redwood Inference
